## Reproduction

Give the clean starting state, sector checkpoint and save fixture, exact actions, expected result, actual result, and frequency. Attach the smallest relevant log recording or fixture through the team's artifact process.

## Recovery and verification

Can the player recover without losing progress? Does this affect earlier saves or required cover? Record a safe workaround if known and the regression case needed to verify the fix.
